facts: The focus is the problem of building large repositories of lexical conceptual structure (LCS) representations for verbs in multiple languages.
A main result is the definition of a relation between broad semantic classes and LCS meaning components.
LEXICALL takes as input the result of previous work on verb classification and thematic grid tagging.
LEXICALL outputs LCS representations for different languages.
LCS representations have been ported into English lexicons.
LCS representations have been ported into Arabic lexicons.
LCS representations have been ported into Spanish lexicons.
Lexicons are currently used in operational foreign language tutoring.
Lexicons are currently used in machine translation.
Previous work is on verb classification.
Previous work is on thematic grid tagging.
